title: ONS 2026 greenhouse-gas emissions-intensity revision QA controls

sources.title: Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gas emissions intensity by industry - current

facts.source_fact: ONS released the 2026 greenhouse-gas emissions-intensity dataset on 5 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach release date to dataset use.

facts.source_fact: The current edition provides data for all economic sectors.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute provisional top-level coverage for current detailed coverage.

facts.source_fact: ONS describes the provisional edition as providing top-level estimates.
facts.expected_handling: Label provisional coverage explicitly.

facts.source_fact: ONS defines GHG emissions intensity as emissions per unit of gross value added.
facts.expected_handling: Carry numerator and denominator definitions with intensity values.

facts.source_fact: Gross value added is the difference between output and intermediate consumption.
facts.expected_handling: Do not interpret GVA as revenue or profit.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 bulletin uses chained-volume GVA measures in constant prices with 2023 as base year for intensity.
facts.expected_handling: Attach GVA price-basis vintage.

facts.source_fact: ONS intensity figures exclude consumer expenditure or households.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix household emissions into industry intensity denominators.

facts.source_fact: ONS reports 140 tonnes CO2e per £1 million GVA for the UK economy in 2024 on this measure.
facts.expected_handling: Attach residence-basis and denominator units.

facts.source_fact: ONS reports economy emissions intensity 72.0% lower in 2024 than in 1990.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve comparison period and method vintage.

facts.source_fact: ONS reports no change in economy emissions intensity between 2023 and 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer sector-level stability from the aggregate result.

facts.source_fact: The Environmental Accounts emissions underlying this intensity measure are residence based.
facts.expected_handling: Do not compare directly with territorial or footprint intensity without reconciliation.

facts.source_fact: Residence-based intensity does not include emissions embodied in goods and services produced overseas and imported to the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Keep consumption-footprint boundary separate.

facts.source_fact: ONS revised the intensity time series to reflect changes in how GVA is calculated.
facts.expected_handling: Treat historical intensity values as revision-sensitive.

facts.source_fact: Improved import and export price measurement for crude oil, natural gas and petroleum products revised energy-sector GVA upward.
facts.expected_handling: Carry denominator-revision provenance into sector comparisons.

facts.source_fact: Following the GVA revision, agriculture is estimated as the most emissions-intensive industry rather than energy.
facts.expected_handling: Do not carry forward superseded rankings.

facts.source_fact: ONS records scheduled updates and revisions in dataset version history.
facts.expected_handling: Use the latest non-superseded version.

facts.source_fact: ONS records a March 2026 correction affecting parts of earlier intensity tables.
facts.expected_handling: Do not use corrected-away figures.

facts.source_fact: Industry classifications use SIC 2007 groupings.
facts.expected_handling: Attach classification version before joins.

facts.source_fact: Intensity uses carbon-dioxide-equivalent emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix raw gas mass with CO2e intensity.

facts.source_fact: The associated Environmental Accounts are accredited official statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Use accreditation as statistical-quality context, not parcel-measurement proof.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable dataset, entity, geography or regulatory boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference period, release/update date and provisional/current/final status.
Carry source URL, publisher and calculation, reporting or quality-method provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert aggregate, facility, industry or scheme-level evidence into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
